capabilities: Rewrite conflicting wikilinks as relative paths like [[../meetings/notes]]
Keep clean [[name]] links when filenames are unique
Fall back to direct paths when the relative path reaches the vault root
extras: Only works with "Files and links > New link format" set to "Shortest path when possible" and wikilinks enabled; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's link format settings are global, so a filename conflict forces a long absolute path even when the target note sits next to the current one.
summary: Wikilink behavior tweak that rewrites conflicting-filename links as short relative paths instead of long absolute vault paths.
